title: Animate landing page hero product-history flow
summary: Replaced the landing page hero's static right-side snapshot specimen with a CSS-driven product-history flow showing plan, implementation, snapshot, evidence, and review records moving through the hero stage. The flow uses transform and opacity animations, responsive positioning, and a reduced-motion fallback.
userVisibleChange: The landing page hero now has an animated right-side flow where plans, snapshots, evidence, and review records smoothly enter, move through, and fade while remaining readable on desktop and mobile.

risks.title: Looping hero motion could distract motion-sensitive users
risks.mitigation: Added a prefers-reduced-motion media query that disables hero flow animations while preserving the static layout.

timeline.title: Planned animated hero flow
timeline.summary: Scoped the change to site/app/page.tsx and site/app/global.css with build verification.

timeline.title: Implemented CSS-driven flow
timeline.summary: Replaced the static hero specimen with staged flow cards and packets, responsive rules, and reduced-motion fallback.

timeline.title: Verified build and browser views
timeline.summary: Ran the site production build and inspected desktop, mobile, and reduced-motion behavior.

decisions.title: Use CSS-only animation for the hero flow
decisions.rationale: The flow is presentational and can be implemented with transform and opacity keyframes, avoiding extra client JavaScript while keeping the server-rendered landing page simple.

decisions.title: Keep inactive cards faintly visible
decisions.rationale: Leaving inactive cards as low-opacity context makes the flow understandable in still frames and during transition moments, while active cards still move forward visually.

decisions.title: Respect reduced-motion preferences
decisions.rationale: Users who request reduced motion should get a readable static flow instead of looping hero animation.

validation.output: Next.js production build compiled successfully, TypeScript passed, and 19 static pages generated.
Captured desktop and full-page mobile screenshots; hero flow cards remained within the stage with no clipped card text or overlapping page controls.
With reducedMotion set to reduce, .eve-flow-card computed animation-name resolved to none.
